lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce home searched in connection with $7 million Southern Truss fraud investigation
lead_independence.lead: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office confirmed to CBS12 News that deputies are serving a search warrant as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

article_framing_rejections.headline: U.S. Marshals arrest baby's father in Fort Pierce malnutrition death investigation

lead_independence.headline: U.S. Marshals arrest baby's father in Fort Pierce malnutrition death investigation
lead_independence.lead: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that the child's biological father, 45-year-old Jason Gunter, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia. Detectives had obtained an arrest warrant for Gunter in connection with the ongoing investigation into the child's death. He has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.
